name: crane-react-jest
description: React's own Jest suite with a browser page in jsdom's place (tests/frameworks/react-jest/README.md). Jest itself comes from React's own node_modules; these are the page's stand-ins for Node's core modules and the Chrome column's driver. is-generator-function stays at 1.0.10: its 1.1 line requires generator-function 2, whose `module-sync` export Node 20.19 resolves to an ES module, which the page's CommonJS loader does not load.
